description: Features & Content Enhancements: Add R.A. 10173/GDPR-compliant cookie consent banner with localStorage persistence, add confirmation modals before destructive actions (delete, revoke), create expandable FAQ section (accordion), add newsletter/advisory signup with success state, implement full-site search component (searches reports, advisories, FAQs client-side), update favicon to Palayan City seal, add social share image asset, configure custom domain for Vercel/Netlify, verify Privacy Policy and Terms & Conditions routes exist and are linked in footer
steps: 1. Create src/components/ui/CookieConsent.jsx: banner fixed bottom-0 with message 'This site uses cookies to improve your experience. We comply with R.A. 10173 (Data Privacy Act of 2012).' Two buttons: Accept (green) and Decline (gray). On Accept, set localStorage.setItem('clima-cookie-consent', 'accepted'). On Decline, set 'declined'. Render only if localStorage.getItem('clima-cookie-consent') is null. Style as non-intrusive bar with subtle shadow, professional government design
2. In App.jsx, render <CookieConsent /> at root level (inside app-shell, high z-index above everything except modals)

3. Create src/components/ui/ConfirmModal.jsx: reusable modal component accepting { isOpen, title, message, confirmLabel, cancelLabel, onConfirm, onCancel, isDangerous }. If isDangerous=true, style confirm button red. Otherwise green. Render with framer-motion AnimatePresence for smooth open/close

4. In AdminDashboard.jsx, find delete operations (delete report line ~3140, delete admin, delete category, delete department, revoke admin access). Before calling delete function, show ConfirmModal with appropriate message 'Are you sure you want to delete this report? This action cannot be undone.' On confirm, proceed with delete
5. In ProfileScreen or ReportModal, if there's a delete/cancel action, show confirmation modal

6. Create src/components/faq/FAQSection.jsx: accordion component with array of { question, answer } objects. Each item has question as button (ChevronDown icon), clicking toggles answer visibility. Use framer-motion for smooth expand/collapse. Style professionally with alternating subtle backgrounds

7. Create src/data/faqData.js: export array of 8-10 FAQ items relevant to disaster reporting, emergency procedures, privacy policy, how to register, what is CLIMA, how to report incident, what happens after reporting, contact information, etc. Write in professional government tone
8. In HomeScreen.jsx or create new FAQScreen.jsx (or add FAQ tab to HomeScreen), render <FAQSection items={faqData} />. If adding new screen, update App.jsx routing and add FAQ nav item to CitizenNav

9. Create src/components/newsletter/NewsletterSignup.jsx: form with email input and Subscribe button. On submit, call Supabase insert to 'newsletter_subscribers' table (create if not exists) or use existing advisory subscription mechanism. Show success message 'Thank you for subscribing to CLIMA advisories!' with CheckCircle icon. Include error handling. Style as card component
10. In HomeScreen.jsx or Footer, render <NewsletterSignup /> below main content or in sidebar

11. Create src/components/search/GlobalSearch.jsx: modal overlay with search input at top. As user types (debounced 300ms), search reports (title, description, location), advisories (title, content), FAQ questions/answers (if FAQ data is accessible). Display results grouped by category (Reports, Advisories, FAQs). Click result navigates to detail or scrolls to section. Use framer-motion for modal animation
12. Create src/hooks/useGlobalSearch.js: hook accepting query string, returns { reports, advisories, faqs } filtered arrays. Use useMemo for performance
13. Add global search trigger: keyboard shortcut (Ctrl+K or Cmd+K) or search icon button in header/nav. On trigger, open GlobalSearch modal

14. If public/vite.svg is still favicon, create/download Palayan City government seal SVG or use existing logo.webp. Convert logo.webp to favicon.ico using online tool or sharp in Node script. Place in public/favicon.ico. Update index.html <link rel='icon' href='/favicon.ico'>

15. Create public/social-share.png: 1200x630px image with CLIMA logo, tagline 'Climate Information Monitoring and Awareness | Palayan City Government', and background image of Palayan. Use Figma, Canva, or Photoshop. Export as PNG
16. Update index.html og:image and twitter:image meta tags to point to /social-share.png (already done in FEAT-001 step 3, verify path is correct)

17. Create vercel.json or netlify.toml in project root for custom domain config. For Vercel: { "github": { "silent": true } }. For Netlify: [[redirects]] _redirects file. Document domain palayan-clima.gov.ph or palayan-clima.ph (user must configure DNS and domain separately, this step adds config file placeholder)

18. In LegalScreen.jsx (already exists at src/screens/LegalScreen.jsx with tabs for Terms, Privacy, Data Processing, Refund, MSA), verify Privacy Policy and Terms of Service tabs are functional. Confirm markdown files exist in public/legal/ directory. If missing, create public/legal/privacy-policy.md and public/legal/terms-of-service.md with professional government legal templates

19. Create src/components/layout/Footer.jsx: footer component with links to Legal (Privacy Policy, Terms of Service), Contact, About, social media icons. Style as dark bar at bottom with subtle border
20. In App.jsx or HomeScreen, render <Footer /> at bottom of main content. Ensure footer appears on all citizen screens (not admin)
21. Run 'npm run build' and test all new features
acceptance_criteria: Cookie consent banner appears on first visit, clicking Accept stores consent in localStorage and hides banner, refreshing page does not show banner again
Before deleting a report, category, or admin, a confirmation modal appears with clear warning message and Confirm/Cancel buttons
FAQ section displays at least 8 questions in accordion format, clicking question expands answer, clicking again collapses it
Newsletter signup form submits email and shows success message 'Thank you for subscribing!'
Pressing Ctrl+K (or Cmd+K) opens global search modal, typing 'flood' shows matching reports and advisories, clicking result navigates to detail
Browser tab favicon shows Palayan City seal icon (not Vite logo)
Social share image (1200x630px) exists at public/social-share.png with CLIMA branding
vercel.json or netlify.toml file exists in project root with custom domain configuration placeholder
Clicking 'Privacy Policy' link in footer navigates to LegalScreen Privacy tab, content loads from markdown file
Footer appears at bottom of all citizen screens with links to Legal, Contact, About
verification: Run 'npm run build' and confirm exit code 0
Run 'npm run dev', open http://localhost:5173 in incognito/private window
Confirm cookie consent banner appears at bottom, click Accept and confirm banner disappears, refresh page and confirm banner does not reappear
Open localStorage in DevTools and verify 'clima-cookie-consent' key is set to 'accepted'

Log in to admin, navigate to a report, click delete icon and confirm modal appears asking 'Are you sure?', click Cancel and verify nothing deletes, click delete again and confirm to verify deletion works
Scroll to FAQ section and click 3 different questions, verify answers expand and collapse smoothly
Enter email in newsletter signup, click Subscribe, confirm success message appears
Press Ctrl+K (Windows) or Cmd+K (Mac) and confirm search modal opens
Type 'typhoon' in search and confirm matching results appear grouped by type
Click a search result and confirm navigation to detail or correct section
Check browser tab favicon and confirm it shows Palayan seal (not Vite logo)
Verify public/social-share.png exists and is 1200x630px with CLIMA branding
Verify vercel.json or netlify.toml exists in project root
Scroll to footer and click Privacy Policy link, confirm LegalScreen opens on Privacy tab, confirm markdown content loads
Verify footer appears on Home, Maps, Profile, Emergency screens (but not on admin screens)
